dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, it's Mona's teach— Or, um, the seer-witch! How come she's still here?

dialogues.speaker: Seer-Witch
dialogues.text: Who goes there? Can you not see I am busy stargazing?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like she's back with us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, since we've got the chance, why don't we ask her to read our fortunes too? After all, according to the book, her prophecies are meant to be super accurate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The only thing is, Paimon's not sure how we're gonna convince her to do that...

dialogues.speaker: Seer-Witch
dialogues.text: How dare you! You take my fortune-telling for some kind of street performance?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry! Paimon's just curious how accurate it is...

dialogues.speaker: Seer-Witch
dialogues.text: Hmph, very well then... I'll show you what my wisdom can do. Come forth, silver sprite — let me see what fate has in store for you.

dialogues.speaker: Seer-Witch
dialogues.text: Hm... You truly wish to know your own fate?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, enough with the suspense already! Is it good or bad!?
